subject: Eval runway & governance checklist for Nimbus pilot
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: James Taylor <james.taylor@nimbushealth.com>, Elena Morris <elena.morris@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed pilot runway

Hi James / Elena — thanks again for the conversation today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we draft the runbook:

Summary from today's call:
- Goal: Reduce time-to-insight for clinical review workflows using Redwood inference embedded summarization + reranking.
- Primary users: clinical reviewers + quality ops.
- Minimal integration: HTTP embedding + rerank endpoint; optional CTA batch job for nightly re-rank.

Proposed pilot (first pass):
1) Duration: 4 weeks (2-week integration + 2-week evaluation window)
2) Success criteria (provisional):
   - Precision@5 for reranking >= 82% vs current baseline (we can lock metrics in runbook)
   - End-to-end 95th percentile latency under 450ms for interactive flows
   - Integration stability: no more than 2 outage incidents during evaluation window
3) Owners:
   - Redwood SE: Rishi (integration and perf tuning)
   - Redwood CS: Monica (runbook, telemetry, acceptance)
   - Nimbus: James (product lead), Elena (security/compliance)
4) Decision point: executive readout within 1 week after evaluation window; go/no-go (contract handoff if go)

Attachments: Nimbus_POC_Summary.pdf (high-level scope & budget placeholder).
Link: Mutual action plan draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcdEFgHijkLmnopqrs

Ask from you: please confirm the proposed success criteria and the owners above; flag any must-have gating items (esp security/compliance) so we add them to the runbook. Also indicate any blackout dates in June for a final exec readout.

I will loop in Monica and Rishi to start a runbook draft once you confirm.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142
From: James Taylor <james.taylor@nimbushealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Morris <elena.morris@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 15:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed pilot runway

Thanks Sergio — this is a helpful summary. A few items from our side:

- Security/compliance: Elena is the best person here. We need SOC 2 Type II and data retention controls documented in the runbook before integration. Can you include the evidence links or an SOC attestation?
- Timeline: 4 weeks sounds right. We prefer the integration window to be the first two weeks of June and the evaluation window the last two weeks (so exec readout target week of June 21).
- Decision criteria: add a QA acceptance gate (sampled clinical cases reviewed by our QA team) and a cost-sensitivity gate (if per-token cost forecast exceeds our threshold, we may need a hybrid config).

I attached the signed NDA for your records.

Also: for exec availability, our VP of Product could join the readout on June 22 or June 24 afternoon (ET). Please hold those windows.

Best,
James Taylor
Director, Product
Nimbus Health
james.taylor@nimbushealth.com
(617) 555-0199

Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call recap + proposed pilot runway

Thanks — drafting the runbook now. Preliminary plan and gating suggestions below:

Runbook (POC_Runbook_v1.docx attached) — sections:
- Overview & scope
- Success criteria (precision, latency, incident budget, cost forecast)
- Acceptance tests (sample set reviewed by Nimbus QA; automated regression set)
- Telemetry & dashboards (Precision@k, latency P50/P95/P99, error rate, model drift signals)
- Rollout & rollback playbook (canary config + fallback model)
- Security & data handling (SOC2 controls, retention policy, audit logs)

Ownership matrix:
- Redwood SE: Rishi — integration, auth, perf tuning (primary contact for infra)
- Redwood CS: Monica — runbook owner, telemetry, acceptance coordination
- Redwood Sales: Sergio — stakeholder management, exec readout coordination
- Nimbus: James (product), Elena (security), QA lead TBD

Gates for go/no-go (proposed):
1) Quality gate: Precision@5 >= 82% on agreed test set and QA sign-off
2) Performance gate: 95th percentile latency < 450ms under demo load
3) Stability gate: no more than 2 severity-two incidents in evaluation window
4) Cost gate: forecasted monthly inference spend within budget threshold (James to confirm threshold)
5) Compliance gate: SOC2 attestation and retention policy agreed

Suggested exec readout slots (ET):
- Tue June 22, 16:00–16:45 ET
- Thu June 24, 15:00–15:45 ET

Next steps (this week):
- Rishi: share integration plan + sample payloads by Wed May 26
- Monica: finalize runbook and dashboard links by Fri May 28
- Sergio: propose calendar invites for both readout slots and confirm attendee list

Attaching POC_Runbook_v1.docx and a short slide deck for the exec readout template.

Monica Patel
Customer Success
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Scheduling final exec readout + contract next steps (Nimbus pilot)

Hi James / Elena — following up to lock the readout and the decision process. Per the runbook and discussions, we propose the following:

1) Final exec readout: Tue June 22, 2027 at 16:00 ET (45 min) — draft agenda attached (SLA-exec-slides.pptx).
2) Goal of readout: review POC outcomes vs gates, present go/no-go recommendation, and if go, agree on next contract milestones (term, committed capacity, start date).
3) Decision authority: Nimbus VP of Product (James to confirm) + Redwood director-level exec (Lauren will attend).
4) Contract handoff: if go, Redwood Sales will send a term-sheet within 48 hours; legal/Procurement can start redline concurrently.

Please confirm the date/time or propose an alternative. Also confirm attendees on your side (VP + procurement or legal). Once confirmed we will send calendar invites and a short pre-read link.

Pre-reads and attachments: POC_Runbook_v1.docx, SLA-exec-slides.pptx
Pre-read link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcdEFgHijkLmnopqrs

Thanks — looking forward to wrapping this up and getting you production-ready.

Best,
Sergio
